summary.en: Two present tenses where French and Romanian have one.
summary.fr: Deux présents là où le français et le roumain n'en ont qu'un.
summary.ro: Două timpuri prezente, acolo unde franceza și româna au unul singur.

heading.fr: Present simple : les habitudes et les vérités
heading.ro: Present simple: obiceiuri și adevăruri generale

body.en:
It describes what is generally true or what you do regularly.
In the third person singular, the verb takes an -s: he works, she lives.
Common words: always, usually, often, never, every day.
body.fr:
Il décrit ce qui est vrai en général ou ce qu'on fait régulièrement.
À la 3e personne du singulier, le verbe prend un -s : he works, she lives.
Mots fréquents : always, usually, often, never, every day.
body.ro:
Descrie ce este adevărat în general sau ce faci în mod regulat.
La persoana a III-a singular, verbul primește -s: he works, she lives.
Cuvinte frecvente: always, usually, often, never, every day.

translation.fr: Elle habite près de la gare.

examples.text: Water boils at a hundred degrees.

translation.ro: Apa fierbe la o sută de grade.

examples.text: We usually have tea at five.

translation.fr: Nous prenons généralement le thé à cinq heures.
translation.ro: De obicei bem ceai la ora cinci.

heading.en: Present continuous: what is happening now
heading.fr: Present continuous : ce qui se passe maintenant
heading.ro: Present continuous: ce se întâmplă acum

body.en:
be + verb + -ing. It describes an action in progress or a temporary situation.
Common words: now, at the moment, this week.
body.fr:
be + verbe en -ing. Il décrit une action en cours ou une situation temporaire.
Mots fréquents : now, at the moment, this week.
body.ro:
be + verb cu -ing. Descrie o acțiune în desfășurare sau o situație temporară.
Cuvinte frecvente: now, at the moment, this week.

translation.fr: Je suis en train de travailler.

examples.text: She's staying with friends this week.

translation.fr: Elle loge chez des amis cette semaine.
translation.ro: Stă la niște prieteni săptămâna asta.

heading.fr: Comparaison avec le français et le roumain

body.en: French "je travaille" and Romanian "lucrez" translate as I work (in general) or I'm working (now), depending on the context. State verbs (know, like, want, understand) stay in the present simple: I know, never I'm knowing.
body.fr: « Je travaille » (comme le roumain « lucrez ») se traduit selon le contexte : I work (en général) ou I'm working (maintenant). Les verbes d'état (know, like, want, understand) restent au present simple : on dit I know, jamais I'm knowing.
body.ro: „Lucrez” (ca și francezul „je travaille”) se traduce după context: I work (în general) sau I'm working (acum). Verbele de stare (know, like, want, understand) rămân la present simple: I know, niciodată I'm knowing.

body.en:
In the present simple, a question puts do (does in the third person) before the subject. The verb then goes back to its base form: Does she work? (not Does she works?).
With be and modal verbs (can, must…), just swap them with the subject: Are you ready? Can you swim?
body.fr:
Au present simple, la question se forme avec do (does à la 3e personne) devant le sujet. Le verbe revient alors à la forme de base : Does she work? (pas Does she works?).
Avec be et les modaux (can, must…), on inverse simplement : Are you ready? Can you swim?
body.ro:
La present simple, întrebarea se formează cu do (does la persoana a III-a) înaintea subiectului. Verbul revine apoi la forma de bază: Does she work? (nu Does she works?).
Cu be și cu verbele modale (can, must…), doar se inversează: Are you ready? Can you swim?

body.en:
do not (don't) / does not (doesn't) + base verb.
In the past, did not (didn't) for every person, and the verb stays in its base form: I didn't go (not I didn't went).
body.fr:
do not (don't) / does not (doesn't) + verbe de base.
Au passé, did not (didn't) pour toutes les personnes, et le verbe reste à la base : I didn't go (pas I didn't went).
body.ro:
do not (don't) / does not (doesn't) + verbul la forma de bază.
La trecut, did not (didn't) pentru toate persoanele, iar verbul rămâne la forma de bază: I didn't go (nu I didn't went).

translation.fr: Je ne mange pas de viande.
Nous ne sommes pas sortis hier.

heading.fr: Comparaison avec le français et le roumain

body.en: French and Romanian can ask a question with intonation alone ("Tu viens ?", "Vii?"). In English, the auxiliary is required: Are you coming?, Do you want some? For negatives, English needs don't / doesn't / didn't, where Romanian puts nu before the verb and French surrounds it with ne … pas.
body.fr: Le français, comme le roumain (« Vii? »), peut poser une question par l'intonation seule (« Tu viens ? »). En anglais, l'auxiliaire est obligatoire : Are you coming?, Do you want some? Pour la négation, l'anglais a besoin de don't / doesn't / didn't, là où le français entoure le verbe (ne … pas) et le roumain place nu devant.
body.ro: Româna, ca și franceza („Tu viens ?”), poate pune o întrebare doar prin intonație („Vii?”). În engleză, auxiliarul este obligatoriu: Are you coming?, Do you want some? Pentru negație, engleza are nevoie de don't / doesn't / didn't, acolo unde româna pune nu înaintea verbului, iar franceza îl încadrează cu ne … pas.

summary.en: have + past participle: a past linked to the present.
summary.fr: have + participe passé : un passé relié au présent.
summary.ro: have + participiu trecut: un trecut legat de prezent.

body.en:
have / has + past participle: I have finished, she has eaten.
Irregular participles must be learnt by heart: go → gone, see → seen, be → been.
body.fr:
have / has + participe passé : I have finished, she has eaten.
Les participes irréguliers s'apprennent par cœur : go → gone, see → seen, be → been.
body.ro:
have / has + participiu trecut: I have finished, she has eaten.
Participiile neregulate se învață pe de rost: go → gone, see → seen, be → been.

examples.text: Have you ever been to Scotland?

body.en:
Past simple (I saw): a finished action at a definite time in the past (yesterday, in 2020, last week).
Present perfect (I have seen): no definite time, or a link with now (ever, never, already, yet, just, since, for).
body.fr:
Prétérit (I saw) : action terminée à un moment précis du passé (yesterday, in 2020, last week).
Present perfect (I have seen) : pas de moment précis, ou lien avec maintenant (ever, never, already, yet, just, since, for).
body.ro:
Past simple (I saw): o acțiune încheiată la un moment precis din trecut (yesterday, in 2020, last week).
Present perfect (I have seen): fără moment precis sau cu legătură cu prezentul (ever, never, already, yet, just, since, for).

examples.text: I saw that film last week.

translation.fr: J'ai vu ce film la semaine dernière.
translation.ro: Am văzut filmul acela săptămâna trecută.

examples.text: I've lived here for three years.

heading.fr: Comparaison avec le français et le roumain

body.en:
The French passé composé and the Romanian perfect compus often translate as a past simple: "Je l'ai vu hier" / "L-am văzut ieri" is I saw him yesterday, never I have seen him yesterday.
French "depuis" and Romanian "din" / "de" with the present become a present perfect: "J'habite ici depuis 2020" / "Locuiesc aici din 2020" is I've lived here since 2020.
body.fr:
Le passé composé français (comme le perfect compus roumain) se traduit souvent par un prétérit : « Je l'ai vu hier » donne I saw him yesterday, jamais I have seen him yesterday.
« Depuis » + présent devient un present perfect : « J'habite ici depuis 2020 » donne I've lived here since 2020.
body.ro:
Perfectul compus românesc (ca și passé composé francez) se traduce adesea printr-un past simple: „L-am văzut ieri” devine I saw him yesterday, niciodată I have seen him yesterday.
„Din” / „de” + prezent devine present perfect: „Locuiesc aici din 2020” devine I've lived here since 2020.

summary.en: When to use an article, and when not to.
summary.fr: Quand mettre un article, et quand s'en passer.
summary.ro: Când folosim articolul și când nu.

body.en: The choice depends on the first sound, not the first letter: a book, a university; an apple, an hour.
body.fr: Le choix dépend du premier son, pas de la première lettre : a book, a university ; an apple, an hour (le h ne se prononce pas).
body.ro: Alegerea depinde de primul sunet, nu de prima literă: a book, a university; an apple, an hour (h nu se pronunță).

body.en: Plural or uncountable nouns used in general take no article: I like coffee, dogs are friendly. the means a specific one: the coffee in this cup.
body.fr: Un nom au pluriel ou indénombrable pris au sens général n'a pas d'article : I like coffee (j'aime le café), dogs are friendly. the désigne une chose précise : the coffee in this cup.
body.ro: Substantivele la plural sau nenumărabile, luate în general, nu au articol: I like coffee (îmi place cafeaua), dogs are friendly. the arată ceva anume: the coffee in this cup.

heading.fr: Comparaison avec le français et le roumain

body.en: French and Romanian use the definite article for general statements (j'aime le café, îmi place cafeaua); English does not.
body.fr: En français, on dit « j'aime le café » avec un article ; en anglais, le sens général se dit sans article : I like coffee. C'est l'erreur la plus fréquente des francophones.
body.ro: În română spunem „îmi place cafeaua”, cu articol; în engleză, sensul general se exprimă fără articol: I like coffee.

summary.fr: Les actions terminées : -ed et verbes irréguliers.

body.en:
Add -ed, the same for every person: I worked, she played, they visited.
It is used with a finished time: yesterday, last week, in 2020.
body.fr:
On ajoute -ed, identique à toutes les personnes : I worked, she played, they visited.
Il s'emploie avec un moment terminé : yesterday, last week, in 2020.
body.ro:
Se adaugă -ed, la fel pentru toate persoanele: I worked, she played, they visited.
Se folosește cu un moment încheiat: yesterday, last week, in 2020.

body.en:
The most common verbs are irregular and must be learnt: go → went, see → saw, have → had, buy → bought.
Questions and negatives use did + base form: Did you go? I didn't go.
body.fr:
Les verbes les plus courants sont irréguliers et s'apprennent par cœur : go → went, see → saw, have → had, buy → bought.
Questions et négations : did + base verbale. Did you go? I didn't go.
body.ro:
Cele mai folosite verbe sunt neregulate și trebuie învățate: go → went, see → saw, have → had, buy → bought.
Întrebările și negațiile folosesc did + forma de bază: Did you go? I didn't go.

summary.en: Verb + particle, with a meaning of its own.
summary.fr: Verbe + particule, avec un sens à part.
summary.ro: Verb + particulă, cu un sens propriu.

body.en: A phrasal verb is learnt as a whole: its meaning often cannot be guessed from its parts. give up = stop trying, get up = leave your bed, look for = search.
body.fr: Un phrasal verb s'apprend en bloc : son sens se devine rarement à partir de ses mots. give up = abandonner, get up = se lever, look for = chercher.
body.ro: Un phrasal verb se învață ca întreg: sensul lui rareori se deduce din părți. give up = a renunța, get up = a se trezi, look for = a căuta.

translation.fr: Je me lève à sept heures.

body.en: With many phrasal verbs, a noun can go before or after the particle: turn off the light, turn the light off. A pronoun always goes in the middle: turn it off.
body.fr: Avec beaucoup de phrasal verbs, un nom peut se placer avant ou après la particule : turn off the light, turn the light off. Un pronom se met toujours au milieu : turn it off.
body.ro: La multe phrasal verbs, substantivul poate sta înainte sau după particulă: turn off the light, turn the light off. Pronumele stă mereu la mijloc: turn it off.
